integration.name: CroplandCROS ArcGIS ImageServer (USDA ARS SCINet, hosts the NASS CDL)
integration.year_selection: At runtime the app queries the catalog and locks the mosaic to the raster with the highest Year whose name matches YYYY_<res>m_cdls. No year is hard-coded.

secondary_integration_checked.name: CropScape CDLService (George Mason University / USDA NASS)
secondary_integration_checked.notes: Used only by scripts/check_dataset.py to cross-check the newest available year and a point value. GetCDLFile (bounded raster download) timed out / returned HTTP 502 in testing, so it is not used for interactive outlines. The CropScape WMS supports only EPSG:4326/EPSG:5070 GetMap and returns rendered colours (several double-crop classes share colours with corn/wheat), so raw class values from the ImageServer are used instead.

geographic_coverage: Contiguous United States (CONUS). Alaska and Hawaii are not covered by the CONUS CDL; FieldWise restricts selection to a CONUS bounding box.

excluded_mixed_categories.explanation: Double-crop classes that include corn or wheat are NOT shown under the simple corn or wheat labels and do not receive crop-specific suggestions. If clicked, the official class name is reported as-is.

class_codes_source: Raster attribute table of the 2025 raster (rasterAttributeTable endpoint of the service above), field Class_Names.
known_limitations: The CDL is a satellite-based supervised classification (random forest), not a field survey. NASS FAQ: producer's accuracy is "generally 85% to 95% correct for the major crop-specific land cover categories"; accuracy varies by state and crop.
Pixels at field edges are harder to classify correctly (NASS FAQ).
Classified regions are connected pixels of one class. They are not ownership parcels, legal boundaries, or verified farm fields.
The classification describes the stated growing season only. It is not proof of what is planted now.
The CDL does not measure soil, irrigation, fertilizer use, disease, management practices or yield.

fallback.policy: If the live catalog query fails, the app uses the last verified record below and labels the dataset status as 'last verified record' with its check timestamp. It never silently substitutes a different year.

evidence: ImageServer catalog query returned 2025_10m_cdls (OBJECTID 40) as the highest Year.
ImageServer identify at Story County, Iowa returned class 1 (Corn) with the mosaic locked to raster 40.
CropScape GetCDLValue for year=2026 reported valid years 1997-2025.
